content: For the customer with the largest outstanding reserve on a single open claim, which policies do they hold?

name: query_salesforce
query_salesforce

content:
The customer is [Copperfield Property Management](/lightning/r/001aj000040sVmdAAE/view). Their open claim [00002123](/lightning/r/500aj00003jKuVjAAK/view) has **$490,000** still in reserve, the most on any single open claim. The claim is on their commercial property policy.

They hold three policies. All are active and all expire on 7 Jan 2027:

| Policy | Line | Annual premium |
|---|---|---|
| [ANT-CP-205061](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKVO7AAO/view) | Commercial Property | $118,000 |
| [ANT-GL-205078](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKVO8AAO/view) | General Liability | $31,200 |
| [ANT-UM-205095](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKVO9AAO/view) | Umbrella | $12,400 |

Together they come to **$161,600** a year in premium.
